name: Destined
source:
You wake up from a glamour to realize that you are about to be sacrificed by the High Lord of the Court of Flames. There is disruption, and a choice you must make. Who will you trust?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你从幻术中清醒过来，才发现烈焰宫廷的大领主马上就要拿你献祭。一场变故突发，你必须作出选择。你会信任谁？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
